stemMd: For what values of $x$ is $4x+7$ at most twice $x+10$?
explanationMd: Translate at most as ≤: 4x+7≤2(x+10). Simplifying gives 2x≤13, or x≤13/2. The boundary makes both expressions equal to 33.

distractorRationale.a: This omits division by the remaining coefficient 2.
distractorRationale.b: At most corresponds to a less-than-or-equal comparison.
distractorRationale.d: This fails to distribute the factor 2 to the constant 10.
